# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser canvas survival-evasion game titled **Elm Street: Stay Awake**. The player is a vulnerable teen dreamer in a surreal boiler-room nightmare. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: immediate play, pointer/touch drag-to-move, collectible proximity pickup, rising threat, delayed stalker pursuit, jumpscare loss on close contact, win when every collectible is gathered, and restart from the end modal. Transform presentation into Nightmare on Elm Street dream-horror through wake-token collectibles, sleep-debt threat labels, red/green nightmare striping, furnace pipes, drifting embers, crooked dream doors, a cyan lucidity beam, and a clawed hat-wearing supernatural stalker. Keep all controls and HUD readable in 4:7 to 9:16 portrait mobile viewports.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-first survival evasion / collection canvas game.
- objective: move the survivor through a vertical playfield and collect all configured items before the stalking entity catches the player.
- input model: pointer/touch hold or drag on the canvas sets a movement target; release clears the target; restart uses a native button click.
- core loop: immediate active play, spawn collectibles, move toward pointer target, collect items on proximity, threat rises over time and per pickup, stalker activates after threat threshold, win at all pickups, lose when stalker remains close long enough to trigger jumpscare.
- fail/friction state: proximity catch triggers a short jumpscare overlay, then game-over modal with restart; optional audio/vibration feedback is gesture-safe.

## Protected Mechanics
- Pointer-to-target movement speed, clamping, update loop cadence, pickup radius, collection counter, threat growth, stalker activation, chase warmup, catch distance, win on full collection, lose on stalker catch, and restart semantics are preserved.

## Remix Blueprint
The remixed game reframes the same survival-evasion loop as an Elm Street dream-horror escape: a lucid teen collects wake tokens in a boiler-room nightmare while sleep debt manifests as a clawed, hat-wearing stalker. Presentation, HUD copy, procedural background, collectible forms, player silhouette, stalker silhouette, and fail/win language are transformed while mechanic truth remains intact.
